name: Meta-Cell Edge Octree Connection
definition: A method to connect mesh components created for individual meta-cells by processing boundary edges that were skipped during initial extraction, using a partial octree structure called edge-octree.
summary: Meta-Cell Edge Octree Connection resolves hierarchical disconnections in adaptive octrees by using a partial octree to process boundary edges skipped during initial extraction, differing from its parent method by focusing on connectivity resolution rather than adjacency graph construction.
